description: Perfect for couples who want their own privacy with the option to still hang out in either pool on the same propertyWelcome to your tropical escape nestled in Rincón, Puerto Rico — just 8-10 minutes from downtown and all the culture, food, and sunsets your heart desires.This unique modern container home was designed with beach lovers, solo adventurers, and couples in mind. With a private pool, outdoor kitchen, and tranquil surroundings, it’s the perfect blend of comfort and Caribbean cool.The space💦Private Pool All to YourselfCool off after a beach day or sip your morning coffee by the water. The pool area is private and peaceful — ideal for sunbathing or night swims under the stars.🍳 Outdoor KitchenCook fresh meals outside in our fully equipped outdoor kitchen with a grill, sink, and prep space. Enjoy your food at the covered dining area with string lights and tropical vibes.🛏️ Cozy, Stylish Living SpaceThis sleek container home includes: • A comfy queen bed with soft linens • A/C and ceiling fan for your ideal temperature • A smart TV and fast WiFi • A compact indoor kitchenette with fridge, microwave, and coffee maker🚿 Spa-Inspired BathroomHot water, plush towels, and locally inspired touches make this a perfect spot to unwind.🌴 Private, Secure & Peaceful PropertyThe home sits on a gated multi-unit property with lush landscaping, parking on site, and plenty of privacy between homes.📍Location, Location, LocationWe’re just an 8-10 minute drive to downtown Rincón (traffic permitting,) known for its surf culture, bars, and famous sunsets. The best beaches, restaurants, and local gems are right around the corner!🧼 Extras to Make You Feel at Home: • Beach chairs + towels • Coffee + basic cooking essentials • Outdoor shower to rinse off after the beach • Locally curated guide to help you explore like a localGuest accessYou will have access to your private container, private bathroom, private pool and outdoor bag out space. The parking area is the only shared space. Your vehicle will be secured inside the fenced area.Other things to note🧳 Perfect For:Solo travelers | Couples | Digital nomads | Surfers | Weekend warriorsWhether you’re chasing waves, recharging in the sun, or exploring the west coast of Puerto Rico, this is your private slice of paradise.Book your stay and come see why people fall in love with this part of the island 🌊

description: Ocean View Penthouse unit is an exquisite retreat nestled in our 5-star-rated Tres Sirenas Beach Inn. This contemporary apartment offers sweeping oceanfront views from both the spacious interior and the expansive private terrace making it a perfect unit to enjoy the breathtaking beauty of Rincon’s sunsets and the convenience of a beachfront stay.Enjoy the comfort and convenience of a stay that includes a delicious breakfast each morning, setting the perfect tone for your day in paradise.The spaceStep into the epitome of coastal living in our stunning Ocean View Penthouse Unit. Designed with a contemporary beach flair, this air-conditioned retreat features a spacious living room with a dramatic vaulted ceiling, offering an open floor plan that seamlessly blends with a fully equipped gourmet kitchen and dining area. The heart of this penthouse is its private 40-foot wrap-around beachfront balcony, accessible through double sliding glass doors. Here, you can unwind on lounge chairs under the shade of an umbrella, soak up the sun, or enjoy a meal al fresco with the sound of the waves as your soundtrack.The Master bedroom is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring a king-size bed, air conditioning, ceiling fans, and a cozy sitting area with a 42″ flat-screen HDTV. Wake up to ocean views and step out onto a secluded balcony with a covered seating area, perfect for sipping your morning coffee. The luxurious master bath is designed for indulgence, complete with a Jacuzzi tub, a separate shower adorned with Murano glass and marble tiles, double vessel sinks, and a private toilet with a bidet.For families traveling with teenage children, a charming loft accessible by a spiral staircase offers two twin-size sleeping sofas and a cozy workspace with a desk and chair.Ideal for couples seeking privacy and tropical beach elegance, the Sea View Penthouse also provides the convenience of a fully equipped kitchen and the personalized services of our boutique hotel. While it can accommodate a family of four, it’s best suited for those with children over twelve or a single couple looking for a romantic getaway.Guest accessGuests will be able to access the pool area with numerous beach lounge beds, lounge chairs, hammock, sitting area, outdoor dining table, BBQ grill and bar.

title: Beachfront Apartment at Pools Beach Rincon "Whale"
description: 1 BR/2BA beachfront apartment with private access to one of the best beaches in Rincon, Puerto Rico- Pools Beach. Queen bed and full size futon style bed in the living area full kitchen, balconies with ocean views, AC in bedroom, cable, Wi-fi, gated parking.The spaceWe are the only vacation rental on beautiful Pools Beach.. Our property includes two apartments that can be rented independently or together as a guesthouse. Each of the 2 units has a master bedroom with a queen bed and a sleeper sofa in the living area. Each apartment can sleep 3 adults or 2 adults + 2 children comfortably. From your balcony you have an unobstructed view of the beach and ocean, enabling you to see whales, surfers, and spectacular sunsets. The break at Pools Beach is a renowned surf destination in Puerto Rico, calm day wading pools next to the house are a treat for all ages!We are within walking distance of restaurants and night life but far enough away that you can just enjoy the sounds of waves. A convenience store, surfing lessons/rentals, and beachfront yoga are also down the street.Our Home is perfect for those seeking a romantic getaway on a quite Caribbean Beach or surfing enthusiasts seeking an amazing beach break. Ours is a hidden gem that keeps quests returning year after year. The local Econo Supermarket is an easy 7 minute drive and has almost everything you would find in the States… The Lighthouse is only 4 to 5 minutes away and a great place to enjoy a sunset. Many more restaurants and culture awaits you in the Rincon Plaza. We are dog friendly for pets under 20lbs.Guest accessThis is a private apartment in a two unit property. Gated parking access is shared, as is beach access and the built in bbq.Other things to noteThis is on the third level of the property, up two flights of stairs.

title: La Luna Suite | Cozy Coastal Retreat
description: La Pina has recently gone through complete updates and enhancements! La Luna Suite is a cozy one-bedroom boutique retreat steps from Rincon’s secluded hidden beach. The suite features a queen memory foam bed with luxurious linens, kitchenette, comfortable living area, private bathroom, New Hi-speed Wi-Fi, and AC. Guests enjoy access to the pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ and kitchen area, plus complimentary beach chairs, umbrella, cooler, and towels for relaxing beach days.The spaceTucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña, including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, an outdoor kitchen and BBQ, a private kitchenette, and our favorite feature, the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella, and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) Your room includes a complete kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), electric hot plate, and all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. The laundry room is free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the foot wash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting into the pool. All kitchens are equipped with cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink, and a large first aid kit is mounted on the wall in the laundry by the door.
